# vue3-json-to-excel

> Vue 3 component that exports JSON to an Excel (.xlsx) file in the browser, built on SheetJS (xlsx). The project site is an online JSON to Excel converter that runs on the component.

Install with `npm i vue3-json-to-excel`. `<vue3-json-to-excel :jsonData="rows" fileName="report" buttonText="Download" />` renders a link that downloads `report.xlsx`. `jsonData` is an object (one row) or an array of objects (one row each), with the keys as column headers. Nested objects become dotted columns such as `shipping.city`, and arrays inside an object are written to one cell as JSON text. Arrays and nested objects need 1.1.0 or newer; 1.0.5 writes one flat object as one row. The default export also has an `install()` method, so `app.use()` registers it globally. `import { toRows } from 'vue3-json-to-excel'` gives the function that flattens the JSON into sheet rows. SheetJS is bundled, so the package installs with no dependencies besides the `vue` peer, and it ships TypeScript types.

## Docs

- [JSON to Excel converter](https://projects.halit.org/vue3-json-to-excel/): online converter, component usage, options and FAQ
- [Blog](https://projects.halit.org/vue3-json-to-excel/blog/): guides on opening JSON in Excel, nested JSON, JSON to CSV, sample JSON files, and SheetJS and Vue 3 code
- [Excel to JSON converter](https://projects.halit.org/vue3-json-to-excel/excel-to-json/): reads .xlsx, .xls, .ods or .csv in the browser and returns the rows as JSON, with an option to rebuild nested objects
- [README](https://github.com/halitsever/vue3-json-to-excel/blob/main/Readme.MD): install, usage, props and a full example
- [Component source](https://github.com/halitsever/vue3-json-to-excel/blob/main/src/vue3-json-to-excel.vue): props, defaults, flattening and the export logic
- [Plugin entry](https://github.com/halitsever/vue3-json-to-excel/blob/main/src/entry.esm.js): default export with install() for app.use(), plus the toRows named export
- [Types](https://github.com/halitsever/vue3-json-to-excel/blob/main/types/index.d.ts): props and toRows signatures
- [Dev example](https://github.com/halitsever/vue3-json-to-excel/blob/main/dev/serve.vue): the local playground that `npm run serve` starts

## Optional

- [Site source](https://github.com/halitsever/vue3-json-to-excel/tree/main/site): the converter page, built with `npm run build:site`
- [Source](https://github.com/halitsever/vue3-json-to-excel): repository
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/vue3-json-to-excel): package page
